About me

A frontend developer who turns ideas into working pages.

I’m Ansari Habibullah Atik, a frontend developer and IT student based in Surat, Gujarat.

I completed my Diploma in Information Technology and I’m currently pursuing my BSc in IT. I enjoy turning ideas into clean, responsive and user-friendly web experiences using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.

I keep improving my skills by building real-world projects and exploring modern web design practices. My goal is to create websites that not only look good but also work smoothly on every device.

I’m open to freelance projects such as business websites, landing pages and responsive website redesigns.

Career / Resume

A little more about me.

I’m a frontend developer focused on creating responsive, interactive and user-friendly web experiences.

How I work

Four steps from your idea to a live page.

Understand

You tell me your goal, your audience and any pages or sites you like.

Design

I share a layout and colors for you to approve before I write the code.

Build

I code the site to be fast, clean and responsive, and send you progress updates.

Review and deliver

You review it, I make the changes you ask for, and then I hand over the final files.

Questions clients ask

Quick answers before we talk.

Will my website work on mobile?

Yes. I build every page mobile-first with Flexbox and Grid, then check it on phone, tablet and desktop sizes.

How do we stay in touch during the project?

Message me on WhatsApp or email. I share updates at each step so you always know where things stand.

Can you change things after delivery?

Yes. Each project includes a review round, and you can contact me later for further changes.

What do you need from me to start?

Your business name, logo, text and photos if you have them, and a few example sites you like. If you don’t have text yet, tell me about your business and we can plan it together.
